name: Raque Food Systems LLC
old_description: American-Built Industrial Food Processing Equipment Since 1975
about:
Founded in 1975 in Louisville, Kentucky, Raque Food Systems has spent more than five decades designing and building custom processing and packaging systems for commercial food producers. The company began as an American-built industrial food processing equipment manufacturer.

Raque specializes in high-speed pie shell stacking, filling, and sealing systems; tray dispensing and sealing lines for ready meals; and pumping, filling, injecting, and topping equipment for dessert production. Its product lines include Industrial Pie Systems, Readymade Meal Processing, and Industrial Dessert Production, along with OEM-quality replacement chains. The equipment is engineered for efficiency, consistency, and long-term performance at scale.

The company serves commercial food producers and manufacturers worldwide, with installations in pie and quiche production, ready-meal manufacturing, dessert and specialty food processing, and bakery operations. Customers range from large-scale food manufacturers to specialty producers seeking customized automation.

Raque differentiates itself by focusing on custom food-packaging machines tailored to each manufacturer’s specific requirements, rejecting a one-size-fits-all approach. The company emphasizes American-built equipment, high-speed production with proven reliability, uncompromising food safety standards, and a service life of three to five years.
